j4q.shaders

Class ColorPhongShader

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.models.Component
      • j4q.shaders.Shader
        • j4q.shaders.ColorPhongShader

  • public class ColorPhongShader
extends Shader
    Shader for rendering colored objects with Phong lighting.

    Supports ambient, diffuse, and specular color configuration and exponent control.
